signal: EL newPayload INVALID / 'failed to decode BAL: EOF'; CL head frozen, low peers; bumping EL image alone did not help
root_cause: ethpandaops moving :<devnet> tags were re-pushed; the CL-side image was stale and mis-relayed the payload to the engine API
remediation: compare pod image digest to the current moving tag FIRST; bump the stale client (here the CL) to the freshly re-pushed digest
trap: debugging it as our EL decoder bug and chasing the EL when the fix was on the CL

signal: CL head stuck, 1 peer (target ~70), '0 peers found to publish attestation'; pods all Running 1/1
root_cause: CL lost peers; EL had nothing to drive so head froze — pod status was a false green
remediation: kubectl rollout restart the CL; it re-discovers peers and drives the head
trap: trusting 'Running 1/1' instead of looking at chain data (peer count, finalized epoch)

signal: module activation omnibus reverts bare on StakingRouter.addStakingModule; addresses have code (not a mismatch)
root_cause: in-pod CLI was on an old branch calling the legacy 8-arg addStakingModule selector; deployed SR uses the struct-based signature (different selector)
remediation: re-checkout the CLI to the branch with the struct-based signature + reinstall; omnibus then encodes the struct
trap: patching the omnibus ABI by hand (fragile) instead of fixing the branch

signal: reporter daemons CrashLoopBackOff: TypeError SignedExecutionPayloadBid.__init__() missing required positional arguments, in consensus types parsing
root_cause: oracle branch modeled the signed bid flat; the CL emits it as {message, signature} per the canonical signed form — a code bug in the branch, not our node
remediation: human — flag the owning oracle team; re-pull the branch once fixed and rebuild
trap: swapping node pairs — an infra remedy for a code fault wastes 50-min redeploys

signal: CMv2 reporter daemons crash with IsNotMember; consensus contract has 0 members
root_cause: the activation omnibus does not register consensus members or grant submit role; those live on the DAO Agent, the deployer cannot add them directly
remediation: human — recommend an omnibus that addMember + grants SUBMIT_DATA_ROLE, then vote
trap: restarting the daemons; the gap is on-chain, not in the pod

signal: perf collector crash-loops requesting pre-checkpoint beacon states; demand floor points below the checkpoint
root_cause: HashConsensus initialEpoch was set below the checkpoint epoch; floor = initialEpoch - frame lands in history no node in the network serves
remediation: front-load: set initialEpoch >= checkpoint at setup. If already past: retrofit = deploy a fresh HashConsensus + setConsensusContract + vote (updateInitialEpoch locks once the epoch arrives)
expected_time_to_green: free if front-loaded; retrofit is a convergence cycle
trap: expecting updateInitialEpoch to fix a live consensus — it is locked after the epoch arrives

signal: right after a consensus re-init/swap the demand floor still shows the old anchor; wiping the daemon DB does not move it
root_cause: the daemon and perf-collector cache the consensus address; they re-read the new one only after a convergence cycle
remediation: wait (restart + let it converge); it can settle overnight
expected_time_to_green: a convergence cycle, up to overnight
trap: concluding the swap 'did not take' and redeploying — it converged on its own by morning

root_cause: the accounting oracle accrued many frames; the packed CL balance increase exceeds annualBalanceIncreaseBPLimit; it will not self-resolve (actual > cap, gap grows each frame)
remediation: human — recommend a bump-sanity-limits omnibus (raise the limit), or do not let the oracle accrue frames
trap: waiting for it to clear on its own; the gap only widens

signal: newly added archive EL pair not yet serving historical getBalance at the depth the heavy oracle report needs
root_cause: besu FOREST archive backward-syncs from the CL checkpoint to genesis; the deep state window fills gradually
remediation: wait for backward-sync to reach the needed depth
trap: swapping the node pair mid backward-sync

signal: oracle daemon decode error on a contract read persists after re-checkout to the expected ref AND after bumping every client to the current moving tag — no available branch/image matches the deployed contract ABI
root_cause: oracle image built for a different contract version than what is deployed; no checkout resolves it
remediation: human — flag owning team; STOP, do not retry infra
trap: re-checkout / node-swap loops when no ref matches

signal: kubectl: the connection to the server 127.0.0.1:16444 was refused; verify-state reports oracles.unreachable=true
root_cause: kube-API tunnel down (or wrong context) — no cluster access
remediation: route to the plumber (NOT diagnosis): ./bin/run.js ssh tunnel + set context
trap: classifying as infra-retryable or 'oracles not deployed'

signal: lighthouse CrashLoop at startup: 'Built-in genesis state SSZ bytes are invalid: OffsetSkipsVariableBytes' — stock lighthouse v6.0.1 (chart default) on a glamsterdam/ePBS network
root_cause: default chart CL image is stock lighthouse, too old to parse the glamsterdam BeaconState SSZ; genesis.ssz was fine
remediation: use the network's fork-aware image: --clImage ethpandaops/lighthouse:<devnet> (and --elImage ethpandaops/geth:<devnet>)
trap: chasing a bad genesis.ssz download; it is the client version, not the file

signal: EL geth engine API -38005 'newPayloadV5 must only be called for amsterdam payloads'; CL sends V5, EL rejects — CL/EL disagree on the amsterdam(glamsterdam) fork activation
root_cause: EL data PVC was first initialised by a stock geth (no amsterdam) and the chain config got baked into the DB; after swapping to the fork-aware geth image the stale stored config persisted
remediation: wipe the EL state (delete the ns or the EL PVC) and redeploy clean with the fork-aware images from the start
trap: swapping the geth image again — the stale DB config persists across image swaps; the PVC must be wiped

signal: pod imageID digest for a :<devnet> moving tag does not match the current registry tag; imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent so a cached (older) digest from earlier work is running
root_cause: ethpandaops re-pushes :<devnet> moving tags; IfNotPresent reuses a node-cached digest instead of the current push
remediation: pin the digest, or set imagePullPolicy=Always + rollout-restart to pull the current tag
trap: trusting the tag name — verify the running imageID digest vs the current registry tag
